fact: Communications minister Raafat Hindy says the Digital Egypt platform currently provides more than 240 digital government services in 29 service bundles, with a target of 400 services in 2030.

Egypt's Ministry of Social Solidarity, with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, launched the first phase of a digital services system for foster families and care institutions on its social-care services platform, where citizens apply and track requests online.
Veto Gate's analysis says the Digital Egypt platform lets citizens complete many government procedures online, from registration and document upload to fee payment, without visiting the agency.

Vetogate reports the Digital Egypt platform offers real estate registration and notarisation services online, including powers of attorney, transaction lookup and office booking, some still needing a visit.

Egypt's Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade says company incorporation applications can be made online on the GAFI portal, in line with Supreme Investment Council decisions on a unified electronic platform.
The government launched the Egypt Digital Platform in 2022, which delivers about 170 government services.

Egypt's Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the pilot of a consular-services app for Egyptians abroad on 2026-10-21, covering 17 missions and consulates, in which citizens complete consular transactions and track their processing.

fact: The article says the number of services on the Digital Egypt platform is targeted to rise from 250 to 500 before the end of 2026, implying 250 are available now.

Egypt's environment ministry, via Minister Manal Awad, says the digital Environmental Impact Assessment system (IDEIA) became operational on 1 November 2026, with all applications to be submitted and tracked electronically and paper no longer accepted.
Assistant ICT minister Mahmoud Badawi says the Digital Egypt platform lets citizens fill in forms, submit applications, pay fees and receive documents electronically.
Badawi says the Digital Egypt platform has about 13.5 million users, growing about 30% a year, with about 90% of use on mobile.

Enterprise reports that Egypt's Digital Egypt platform lets people complete online civil status documents, traffic fines, criminal record certificates, social insurance, ration card, labor registry, credit inquiry and commercial registry services, with payment online.

Enterprise reports that one Digital Egypt account, opened with the 14-digit national ID and linked mobile number, works across civil status, traffic, real estate, court and commercial registry services.
Minister Mohamed Farid says new digital services are being made available to exporters with the ICT ministry and e-Finance.
MCIT's 2024 Yearbook says the Digital Egypt platform spans 14 service categories and offers nearly 200 digital government services.
MCIT's 2024 Yearbook says the Digital Egypt platform's registered users passed 8 million in 2024, with about 11 million service requests and inquiries.
